in_sanskrit.name: चयनि
in_sanskrit.meaning: चयन (choice) + ई (I) = चयनी (one who is chosen)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chayani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चयन' which means 'choice'. The suffix 'ई' (I) is added to it to make the name feminine. Thus, Chayani means 'one who is chosen'.

in_marathi.name: Chayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity and abundance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaya', meaning shadow or reflection. In Hindu mythology, Chayani is the goddess of prosperity, abundance, and nourishment. She is often depicted as a goddess of the earth and is believed to provide sustenance and protection to her devotees.
